chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: The Black vaudeville circuit across fifteen cities
summary: Danny lists the TOBA theatres from Atlanta to Memphis and Chicago, and the stars who graduated to the Orpheum and Pantages circuits.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So when you played the Eighty-One Theatre, man, you had to be, like, you know, good, or you didn't make more than one show. So the Eighty-One Theatre and the theatre in Baltimore, and there was one in Memphis... Man, there must have been about fifteen cities. Birmingham, Alabama. Mobile...

Pensacola. Dallas. Houston. Little Rock, Arkansas. Memphis. Going up... Memphis, Chicago... There was something in between. But you could play that Black circuit. And they had their stars. Some of the stars graduated and went on to the Orpheum circuit. And then ones played on the Pantages circuit and went from New York...from
Yeah, the Whitman Sisters were out in Chicago.
